english.title: Dishonestly sub-let / part with possession of a dwelling-house let under assured tenancy in breach of a term of tenancy

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: prevention of social housing fraud act 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a tenant of a dwelling-house let under an assured tenancy to which section 2 of the Prevention of Social Housing Fraud Act 2013 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ADDRESS..), dishonestly and in breach of an express or implied term of the tenancy,

(A)_[sub-let]_
(B)_[parted with possession of]_

(C)_[the whole of the dwelling-house]_
(D)_[part of the dwelling-house, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE HOUSE..),]_

and ceased to occupy the dwelling-house as your only or principal home
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(2) and (7) of the Prevention of Social Housing Fraud Act 2013.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: An unlawful profit order may be made by a court in relation to a defendant convicted of this offence - see section 4 of the Act for further details.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates' court, see section 2(7) of the Prevention of Social Housing Fraud Act 2013 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
